correctness.rationale: Reconstructed quotient-Hessian as four t^2 times discrete-Gaussian shifted variance and equality at shift zero (with the established shifted-covariance inequality cited from Letwin--Reis--Rothvoss). Differentiation gives A prime=4t(2m-tv); Jacobi transform controls t<=2, cumulant comparison controls 2<=t<=3, tail bound gives negativity beyond 3, establishing one maximizer. Independent high-precision theta sums found t*=2.353015289448131648865384 and A*=3.550276615992224481628183. Product Hessian diagonal gives minimum of A(t_j)/a_j^2 and rigidity on longest sides. Numerical check does not prove the imported shift inequality or the global analytic signs; proof cites explicit inequalities.
